description: This Kotlin source file provides extension functions for converting a list of CreateShareResponse objects into OCShare objects within the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It includes functions to map responses and set various properties of share objects.

methods.name: toOCShareList
methods.description: Converts a list of CreateShareResponse objects into a list of corresponding OCShare objects, filtering out any with id -1.

methods.name: toOCShare
methods.description: Converts a single CreateShareResponse object into an OCShare object, mapping fields and setting properties accordingly.
